title: Safe execution to a postcondition
statement: For a resource limit record $L$, a statement $s$, an initial state $\sigma$, and a predicate $R$ on states, say that $s$ runs from $\sigma$ to $R$ under $L$ precisely when $s$ is block-safe under $L$ in $\sigma$ and $R$ holds of the state obtained by executing $s$ from $\sigma$.
